content_sections.heading: About ASMC Bahraich
content_sections.text: Maharaja Suheldev Autonomous State Medical College and Maharshi Balark Hospital is a government medical college with an attached hospital in Bahraich, Uttar Pradesh (PIN 271801). The notice is issued by the Office of the Principal (प्रधानाचार्य कार्यालय). Its fee clause calls the institution "ASMC and Associated Teaching Hospitals Bahraich". The office can be reached on 05252-237621 or at [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice advertises 05 posts of Non PG Junior Resident (Hospital Administration) on a contract basis. The posts are divided by category as follows: The notice says that reservation for these seats will be applied as per U.P. Government rules. It also says that the number of posts may decrease or increase. Eligibility is decided on the basis of MBBS/BDS plus a 02-year full-time PG degree, Masters in Hospital Administration, from any medical institution, and on NMC norms. Candidates must also be permanently registered with the Medical Council of India or the U.P. State Medical Council. The age limit for the Non PG Junior Resident (Hospital Administration) posts is admissible only up to 40 years. A candidate who has been presented before the MCI/NMC by any other medical college for session 2025-26 is not eligible for this walk-in interview. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: One set of self-attested photocopies of all original certificates Two photographs Relevant records A Demand Draft of Rs 1,000/- (One thousand rupees only) for the application fee, made in favour of "Principal, ASMC and Associated Teaching Hospitals Bahraich"

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Come to the Office of the Principal, Bahraich, on 27 October 2026 or on any Tuesday or Friday after that. Interviews run from 10:00 to 02:00. Hand in your application by the 12:00 reporting time. Forms are not accepted after 12:00, and late candidates are not allowed to take part in the interview. Take the walk-in interview. If more than one candidate applies, selection is made on merit, based on the marks obtained in the interview. The vacancies are filled on a first come first serve basis.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointment is on contract for 89 days. The notice says the term will be extended according to work performance. The appointment ends automatically after the fixed period. Services may also be ended earlier without any prior information or notice. The appointments are purely temporary. They are subject to the final decisions of the Government and of the Maharaja Suheldev Autonomous State Medical College Society, Bahraich. The college administration will end the appointment if the appointee obstructs departmental work in any way or does not fully carry out departmental work. Non PG Junior Residents (Hospital Administration) will work under the Head of Department, Hospital Administration. Otherwise, they will work under the Chief Medical Superintendent or the Medical Superintendent. No travel allowance or TA/DA is paid for attending the interview. The notice is valid for 89 days only.

faq.question: Q1. When is the ASMC Bahraich Junior Resident walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview starts on 27 October 2026. After that, it is held every Tuesday and Friday from 10:00 to 02:00.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time for the walk-in?
faq.answer: The reporting time is 12:00. Forms are not accepted after 12:00, and late candidates are not allowed to take part in the interview.

faq.question: Q3. Where is the walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: The interview is held at the Office of the Principal, Maharaja Suheldev Medical College and Maharshi Balark Hospital, Bahraich.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are there in ASMC Bahraich Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 05 posts of Non PG Junior Resident (Hospital Administration): General 02, OBC 02 and SC 01. The number of posts may decrease or increase.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is required for the Non PG Junior Resident (Hospital Administration) post?
faq.answer: Candidates need MBBS/BDS plus a 02-year full-time PG degree, Masters in Hospital Administration, from any medical institution, as per NMC norms. They also need permanent registration with the Medical Council of India or the U.P. State Medical Council.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is admissible only up to 40 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee and how is it paid?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs 1,000/-. It is paid by Demand Draft in favour of "Principal, ASMC and Associated Teaching Hospitals Bahraich".

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates bring to the walk-in?
faq.answer: Bring one set of self-attested photocopies of all original certificates, two photographs and the relevant records.

faq.question: Q9. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: If more than one candidate applies, selection is made on merit, based on the marks obtained in the interview. The vacancies are filled on a first come first serve basis.

faq.question: Q10. Is the ASMC Bahraich Junior Resident job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely temporary and on contract for 89 days, and the notice says the term will be extended according to work performance. Services may be ended earlier without notice.
